name: EMD cycle-versus-trend mode switch
note: Ehlers' empirical mode decomposition regime switch, implemented from his Figure 9 listing. A 2-pole bandpass on (high+low)/2 isolates the swing component; its mean over 2*Period bars is compared to a fraction of the 50-bar average of the tracked local peaks and valleys of the bandpass itself. Mean above Fraction*AvgPeak is UPTREND, below Fraction*AvgValley is DOWNTREND, otherwise CYCLE -- and the mode changes the RULE SET, not just permission to trade. Uptrend: long on a bandpass cross above zero. Cycle: long on a cross above AvgValley, short on a cross below AvgPeak. Downtrend takes no longs (dn_short=1 adds the mirror short on a zero cross down). Exits are the mode's own: the regime at the entry bar decides which exit applies.
source: John F. Ehlers and Ric Way, 'Empirical Mode Decomposition: A novel approach for cycle and trend mode detection', https://www.mesasoftware.com/papers/EmpiricalModeDecomposition.pdf -- Figure 9 EasyLanguage listing (beta/gamma/alpha bandpass recursion, Mean = Average(BP, 2*Period), Peak/Valley detection, AvgPeak/AvgValley = Average(...,50), Fraction thresholds) and the concluding trend/cycle delineation rule.
